$comment: M02e look shots (M02g1 adds `a1-truck` and `a1-burnoff`: the chase pose 8.5 m behind the tow truck at the synth Yard of m.a1.01, at the stage start in Karl fog at 06:30 and 60 s of real time later, 07:00 clear; they need the story running, `?play=story&story=1`, and are not part of the M02e goldens): fixed cameras for the goldens (tests/e2e/golden/look) and the before/after image (docs/look). ENU metres from City Hall (+X east, -Z north); y is the eye height above the ground under the camera; yaw 0 looks north (-Z), 90 west. Positions of the first four are in the Civic Center and the commercial blocks of the synth world, which every CI run bakes; the two `sf-civic-*` shots stand on Civic Center Plaza of the real `sf` bake (the before/after of `docs/look`, optional) and are not part of the goldens. The hour and weather are locked with a zero-second blend. M02g2 adds three pairs for the flicker check (tests/support/flicker.ts); the two shots of a pair are 0.05 m apart along +X and share everything else, so a stable surface differs little between them and one that sparkles or moires does not. `junction-graze` looks north 1.3 m above the x = 60 avenue at its junction with the z = 136 street of the synth street grid, 64 m ahead; `asphalt-low` looks along the same avenue 1.0 m above the asphalt, 8 degrees down; `civic-hall-graze` stands on the x = -100 street and looks at the south front of the City Hall landmark at a 35 degree graze. None is part of the M02e goldens. M02h1 adds `markings-near` (the signalised four-lane junction of the x = 60 avenue and the z = 296 street, seen from the northbound approach 33 m south of it, 5 m up) and the pair `markings-graze` / `markings-graze-b` (the centre line of the x = 60 avenue at 1.6 m, looking north along 400 m of straight road; the second shot of this pair is 0.05 m to the east, at the same height, and the flicker case counts only the road 80 to 330 m ahead: along the road the same pixel of the two pictures sees the same lateral coordinate, so a pair 0.05 m further along cannot show a line that sparkles, and across it the paint within 80 m moves by more than a pixel, which is parallax; out there a 5 cm step moves a line by under a third of a pixel, so a hard-edged line flips pixels and a filtered one changes by under 50/255, and the case counts a change past 96/255): the `@markings-golden` shots.
